_note: One of the 20 sets of ichava/icon-sets-extras, each refreshed by its own config into files/<set>/ and licenses/<set>/, with its version recorded at upstream.sets.<set>.current_version in the pack's config.json. 2D/svg/emoji_u<codepoints>.svg, slugged (emoji-u1f600). The root LICENSE is the OFL and covers the fonts; 2D/svg/LICENSE is the Apache-2.0 notice that governs the SVGs, so the licence is read from there (licence_from) and pinned by SHA-256. 170 SVGs declare Adobe Illustrator entities in an internal DTD, which the sanitiser cannot parse, so they cannot be checked and are dropped (drop_unparsable). The tagged archive is 1.2 GB, almost all of it 3D PNGs, so this source raises the download cap to 2 GiB. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 3,580 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
name: icon-sets-extras.noto-emoji
